settings.text:
You’ve probably tried something for your hair already. It didn’t work. That’s not a coincidence — most hair supplements were never built for this.

This one is.

Your GLP-1 mimics a famine signal. Your body responds by shutting down non-essential activity. Hair growth is first to go. A cellular process called autophagy keeps your follicles in the active growth phase. When it slows down, shedding starts.

Most supplements target deficiencies. Spermidine targets the signal itself.

It’s the only compound shown to restart autophagy at the follicle level. Making hair growth start again.

In a double-blind clinical trial, women saw a statistically significant increase in active hair follicles. Results held 3 months even after they stopped taking it.

Goodwell delivers 10 mg of pharmaceutical-grade spermidine per serving. More than most people get in an entire week of food.
